recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-32983; future changes to these codes should be handled in THO and, for Citation bindings, the EBM IG source rather than by reintroducing core Citation terminology files.
issue_request: FHIR-32983 was a Published CDS change request with a Persuasive with Modification resolution to add accepted, approved, and created to the CitedArtifactStatusType code system and value set used by Citation.citedArtifact.currentState and Citation.citedArtifact.statusDate.activity, with definitions more explanatory than the display names.
initial_application: The request was applied by git commit 2604ce005b048a78ece942b4b995dd6d4be735ce, which added created, accepted, and approved plus expanded definitions to source/citation/codesystem-cited-artifact-status-type.xml. R5 history still contains those codes, and CDS/COKA Confluence notes from July 1, 2021 record the definitions developed to apply FHIR-32983.
additional_context: FHIR-32322 was the broader Citation value-set request from which this status-type work was split. FHIR-34446 later changed the same status family by adding unknown/status alignment context. FHIR-39632 moved many CDS/Citation terminology definitions out of core and into THO, and a later cleanup removed the Citation resource from the FHIR core build and changed core narrative to point to the Evidence Based Medicine on FHIR IG.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source/fhir.ini has no active Citation or cited-artifact-status-type build entry, current core has no active source for the cited-artifact-status-type CodeSystem or ValueSet outside OID and historical release records, THO includes created/accepted/approved, and the HL7/ebm Citation source binds currentState and statusDate.activity to the THO value set.

related_jiras.note: Broader Citation value-set request that originally included the three CitedArtifactStatusType codes before this seed handled them separately.

Applied issue that moved duplicated CDS/Citation CodeSystem definitions out of core and into THO.
